b0595924-73f7-49c4-94b0-b05017d77ef8.address: 20 Shwe Taungyar Street, Bahan Township, Yangon

items.text: Founded in 1955 as a non-profit Pre-K to Grade 12 school in Bahan Township. About calls it the oldest international school in Myanmar. Accredited by WASC, IB-authorised, and an EARCOS member.

About says almost 500 students from more than 27 countries, with a nationality cap so no more than 30% of each grade is one nationality. The 2025–26 largest groups named are Myanmar, United States, South Korea, India, and Thailand. Home tiles say 500+ students and 27+ nationalities.
items.source: Official website — About ISY and Home

items.text: Apply for 2026–27 sets class-size guidelines: Chinthe Cubs 3 (16), Chinthe Cubs 4 (18), Kindergarten and Grade 1 (20), Grades 2–12 (22). The Director may grant exceptions.
Campus walk named on Visit ISY: colonial administration building, SAS building, Chinthe Cubs classrooms, swimming facilities, and a re-surfaced football pitch.
Security page: trained on-campus security 24/7, plus fire, earthquake, and lockdown drills. Clinic: one doctor and a nurse during school hours, first floor of SAS.
School year is August to June. English is the medium of instruction. At least one parent or primary caregiver must be fluent in English.

f6c7b97d-8959-4d0c-841f-8148d10dcd4d.address: Campuses include Thuwana, Parami (Hlaing), North Dagon, Dagon Seikkan, and Thumingalar 123

items.text: ILBC says it has branches in nine major cities across Myanmar.
Named Yangon-area campuses in official pages and posts include Thuwana, Parami (No.1, Parami Road, Hlaing), North Dagon, Dagon Seikkan, and Thumingalar 123.
Preschool pages describe outdoor activities and field trips at more than one campus.

6d0e010f-b869-4350-ae90-5a30f531d22d.address: No. 24, Sae Myaung Street, 11th Quarter, Yankin Township, Yangon

items.text: All-through campus from early years (nursery and reception) to year 13 (sixth form).
After-school activities include sports programmes and community-based projects.
A sister campus in Mandalay opened in 2018.

items.text: Home page lists six Dagon campuses: Manawhari 9/B, 301 Shwedagon Pagoda Road, 293 Shwedagon Pagoda Road, Padonmar 15-D, Padonmar 15-A, and Pyidaungsu Yeiktha 44.
MOE currently lists three Helix rows: Padonmar 15 D, Manawhari 9, and 301 Shwedagon Pagoda Road. 293, Padonmar 15-A, and Pyidaungsu are on the website but not on those three MOE rows.
items.source: Official website — Home and MOE approve list

items.text: Programs intro says academic programmes start at Primary 4 through IGCSE. Official 2026 pamphlets also advertise Pre-School, Primary 1–6, Secondary, A Level, and an OSSD pamphlet.
About: Edexcel Approved Centre No. 94981, exams with British Council Yangon. Online courses are offered in all academic programmes.

d1e8deee-ed2c-43fb-a382-c3adb5d06861.school_name: Pride ISM Pride International School Myanmar
d1e8deee-ed2c-43fb-a382-c3adb5d06861.address: Aung Chan Thar 4th Street, Aung Myay Thar Zi, Kamayut, Yangon, Myanmar

items.text: About says Pride ISM opened in Yangon in 2001–2002 and now has four campuses: Early Years, Primary, and Secondary in Yangon, plus a Mandalay sister campus from March 2005.
The About overview also says three campuses: Early Years, a combined Primary and Secondary site in Yangon, and Mandalay. Those two official counts do not match.
Admissions says the school has provided education for more than 14 years and currently serves about 1,200 students. Office hours: 7:30 a.m.–4:00 p.m. in term time.
School year is about 184 teaching days from late August to June. About sets class size at 24 maximum; FAQ sets maximum class size at 25.
Mandalay overview: Pre-Nursery through Secondary, more than 200 students, same EYFS and Key Stage 1–3 programme as Yangon, 09:00–15:00, 185 teaching days, class size 24.
MOE lists two separate Pride ISM rows: Kamayut, Yangon, and Chanmyathazi, Mandalay, both 2024–2025 to 2028–2029.

items.text: Home page: established 2009, six branches, preschool to IGCSE, NCUK IFY, A Levels, and overseas-education advice.
Campuses named on the home page: Pun Hlaing, Star City, Golden Valley, Taunggyi, Thuwunna, and KIC Bahan.
Thuwunna is the largest campus: three buildings, Nursery to Key Stage 4, head office at No. (6/A), Kyoe Sett Yone Street, Thingangyun.
items.source: Official website — Thuwunna Primary and Contact

items.text: Star City: Preschool to Lower Secondary, Cambridge Curriculum, class size 20–25, enrolment from under 100 in 2023–24 to over 200 in 2025–26. Address No.1/B, Plot No.2, Star City, Thanlyin.
items.source: Official website — Star City and Contact

items.text: Pun Hlaing: Cambridge British international curriculum from Early Years to Lower Secondary, next to Pun Hlaing Estate, Hlaing Tharyar.
items.source: Official website — Pun Hlaing and Contact

items.text: Golden Valley: bamboo campus and EYFS preschool. Contact lists No.43 Golden Valley Road. MOE lists No.43 Inya Myaing Road, Bahan.
items.source: Official website — Golden Valley / Contact and MOE

items.text: Taunggyi: Nursery to Year 8, No. (70/10) Haw Sandar Road. The Contact page repeats this address under KINGS College.
KIC Bahan: NCUK IFY and Pearson Edexcel A Levels at a downtown Yangon college campus. MOE has a separate Bahan row at No.15 Shwe Gon Taing 4th Street.
